bio: Corentin Lonnoy, affectionately known as Coco, has realised his childhood ambition by transforming his family abode into a delightful restaurant adorned with nostalgic photographs of Bierwart. Having honed his skills alongside Pierre Résimont, his genuine enthusiasm for high-quality ingredients shines through in his culinary creations. One standout dish features Anjou pigeon fillet complemented by intriguing accompaniments such as potato millefeuille, confit beetroot, blackberries, and a robust jus. The tempting set menu offers the perfect opportunity to savour this approachable yet refined cuisine....
